title: Krawtchouk polynomial evaluated at an integer
statement:
Fix a natural number $n$, and let $j, x$ be natural numbers with $j \le n$ and $x \le n$. Then the Krawtchouk polynomial $K_j^{(n)}$, evaluated at the real number $x$, equals the alternating sum
\[
  K_j^{(n)}(x) \;=\; \sum_{i=0}^{j} (-1)^i \binom{x}{i}\binom{n-x}{j-i}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: n, j, x are natural numbers
replaced:
For $j \le n$ and $x \le n$, evaluating the polynomial $K_j^{(n)}$ at the real number
$x$ gives the value $K_j^{(n)}(x)$ of the alternating-sum definition.
